findings.title: allow_engine permits any same-run GPU engine for 59s after delete
findings.evidence: require_helper_only skips the gpu_pids subset check when allow_engine=True; validate_native_idle passes allow_engine=second<60; only second=60 is helper-only; tests only cover final row
findings.impact: per-cycle 60s observation can pass with a model engine retaining GPU context for 59s, contrary to only-registered-helper requirement
findings.verification: set allow_engine=False for all rows or define explicit bounded engine transition; add engine at second 0 and 59 negative tests

findings.title: native idle raw gpu_processes not cross-bound to host monitor/gpu_pids
findings.evidence: idle rows write raw gpu_processes and host_gpu_snapshot; validate_native_idle only checks host_gpu_snapshot and ignores raw gpu_processes; test fixture has gpu_processes=1124 while gpu_pids=[9001] and passes
findings.impact: raw NVML can show an engine while host monitor ready is helper-only; accept can pass an inconsistent per-cycle GPU receipt
findings.verification: parse idle gpu_processes PIDs and require equality/subset with host_gpu_snapshot.gpu_pids and helper; update fixture and add negative test

findings.title: ancestor memory.swap.max not validated; root missing interface allowed
findings.evidence: values include memory.swap.max but validate_ancestor_values only loops memory.max/high; root None is explicitly accepted
findings.impact: ancestor swap or root interface absence does not fail preflight; current SwapTotal=0 lowers risk but the all-ancestor swap claim is incomplete
findings.verification: validate memory.swap.max and root interfaces; add tests for swap>0 and missing root interface
